GPTR-F-001-S169.title: Core Allowlist Enforcement Engine
GPTR-F-001-S169.description: Implement the core enforcement logic that validates normalized GPTReader requests against the allowlist schema, rejecting any disallowed collections, fields, operators, or query shapes before execution.

GPTR-F-001-S170.title: GPTReader API Enforcement Wrapper
GPTR-F-001-S170.description: Integrate the enforcement engine into the GPTReader Azure Function entrypoint so that every incoming request is validated prior to MongoDB execution, with standardized error responses for violations.

GPTR-F-001-S171.title: Allowlist Enforcement Test Suite (Negative and Limits)
GPTR-F-001-S171.description: Develop unit and integration tests covering invalid queries, disallowed fields, operator injection attempts, and boundary conditions such as max document limits and payload size caps.

GPTR-F-001-S172.title: End-to-End Enforcement Integration with Auth and Tooling
GPTR-F-001-S172.description: Ensure enforcement is applied consistently across authenticated GPTReader access paths, validating that no request can bypass allowlist checks when invoked via Brain runner, tool routing, or direct API access.
